title: [finding] `skills/*/references/_index.md` is generator-owned (`gen:skill-refs`) yet sits inside the `skills/**` governed-merge fence — every spec PR touching an indexed headline is forced to carry a governed-surface file
body:
Filed unassigned by the `domain:spec` seat (`session_01Rxnd8cyFnoU8V5y21PaTsy`) — recording a rule collision measured today, not proposing its resolution. Skills-lane subject (governed-fence semantics); triage/skills seat grades.

## The collision, measured on PR #11685 (2026-08-24)

- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` is **generated**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-refs` (`packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-references.ts`), enforced by `check:skill-refs` inside the `Type Check · source gates` CI job. The gate's own words: "These files are GENERATED — do not hand-edit them. Regenerate and commit."
- The spec retirement PR #11685 changed `responsive.zod.ts`, so the generator's output for that file's headline changed; the regenerated line rode the PR (correctly — 产物随源走).
- The dispatching seat (me) misread it as a hand-authored `skills/**` edit and ordered it split out under the governed-merge fork ("one governed path hit ⇒ the whole PR is human-merge-only"). Result, measured: head `7125cdc6e` went **red on `check:skill-refs`** (job 97435569091) — the split is not merely wrong, it is **unworkable**: landing the spec change without the regenerated file turns MAIN red on the same gate until a follow-up lands. Corrected same hour (regenerate + recommit; PM correction recorded on #11027, comment 5395784586).

## Why this needs a ruling rather than a seat convention

The governed-merge fence (`docs/adr/**` + `.claude/**` + `skills/**` + `AGENTS.md` + `CLAUDE.md`, maintainer rulings 2026-08-08 / 08-11 / 08-18) exists so agent-authored instruction/skill CONTENT reaches main only through a human merge. A generator-owned index regenerated mechanically from `packages/spec` is inside the fence's path glob but arguably outside its intent — and the gate FORCES it into any spec PR whose diff moves an indexed headline, so under a strict reading every such spec PR loses merge-queue eligibility.

Options for whoever grades this (not recommended-ranked here — the fence is a maintainer ruling and narrowing it is not a seat's call):

- **A** — carve out generator-owned files (the `gen:skill-refs` output set, machine-enumerable from the generator) from the governed fork; the generator + its gate are the review.
- **B** — keep the strict reading: any spec PR carrying a regenerated `_index.md` takes the human-merge path. Consistent, heavy: it converts a mechanical regen into a queue-ineligibility bit on ordinary spec PRs.
- **C** — move the generated index out of `skills/**` (generator emits to a non-governed path; skill packaging assembles it at publish time). Build-system change; ends the collision structurally.

Evidence trail: PR #11685 · job 97435569091 log (verbatim gate text) · #11027 comments 5394936412 / 5395784586 · precedent findings on the fence itself: #9319, #9404 (both closed).
